detail.longDescription:
Why does everyone use Alire? Screw Alire.

Do you know what would help? If we got Ada support in Autoconf and Automake.

I have taken lately to using libtool instead of gnatlink. I have not quite worked out automating dependencies but that is a technical problem that occurs again and again. I once worked it out for my own Guile 2.0 development, for instance (where it could be done by scanning s-expressions).

If you Autotool Ada then you can use it in lieu of C.
